judge.note: Subagent instance; the author is the Chief (Fable 5.2). Nothing outside reviews/qre/ was edited.

verdictBasis: One BLOCKING finding (QRE-STR-A-01): the N4 in-force anchor is rewritten from a fallback, so after a permanent equipment loss and regain the plane slots stay on band/bodyweight or lose the vertical, where the frozen engine returns to external loading. Freezing would bake it into the authorized bytes of a frozen file. The fix is bounded.

findings.statement: planeAlternation.built is rewritten from the natural pick on every rebuild; once the built configuration stops fitting, the fallback becomes the anchor and is kept after the built one fits again.

reproduction.steps: INTERMEDIATE, full gym, 2 days, DEV; weeks 0-1 reviewed; EQUIPMENT_CHANGE (permanent) to [BANDS] at week 2; weeks 2-3; EQUIPMENT_CHANGE back to the full gym at week 4.

findings.suggestedFix: Keep the in-force anchor S.inForce[type:slot] as built when there is one (record natural.list[0] only for a new plan).

findings.statement: After a trunk set-aside (dead-bug, SKILL_MISMATCH or preference) in a bodyweight 5-day plan, the CORE template's second TRUNK slot is unfilled (6 -> 5 trunk rows a week) and the gap is not declared (plan negotiation lists only PULL; no disclosure); only template.missingPatterns holds it. OFF fills it with a plank.

--preserved and --write never check the four earlier freeze records against their committed bytes; (iv) excludes them. An edited RUNTIME_FREEZE_V1RFC_1.json (alone, or with the runtime-read SSCTR_V1RFC_RUN_RECORDS.json changed and its hash updated in the record) passes with exit 0. --check catches a record change only after a write.
findings.note: Records unchanged at 21838cb (git diff 2dfa216 21838cb -- CoachingCore/v1 shows only the values file).

findings.statement: The binding program.repertoire.strengthExtension is enforced only by v1-strength-index.mjs; through v1-index.mjs (custody today) and v1-run-forecast-index.mjs a plan built under the rules is reviewed without them, and an equipment change through v1-index.mjs brings front-plank back.

Any change in the selection-boundary state strands every plan in force (UNSUPPORTED), including a review with a fresh warning sign (UNSUPPORTED, not CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED). Mirrors the frozen event-extension mismatch; four new triggers. Integration needs a restart path.

The amended frozen file makes the frozen entry points honour a strength field on a caller-supplied repertoire authority (inert at 2dfa216): v1-index plan hash 29f0b2dd -> 10a89640, dead-bug and front-plank removed, malformed binding {id:null,sha256:null,boundaries:[]}. Dev/test path only.

N4 changes the dose of exercises it did not select (db-row 282 rows, seated-cable-row 144 rows: reps 8 -> 10 to the last week) and lat-pulldown (112 rows) in 66 of 432 lifter plans, all NONE/NOVICE. N1 changes the replacement trunk row set count (x1 -> x2) and session minutes (+2..3) in 2,160 / 2,242 sessions. No session exceeds the strength minutes (0 of 31,104).
52 of 74 mutants killed; 15 non-equivalent survivors; add tests killing at least R18, V05, V17, V25, X03, X15, X19, X20, each guarding a claimed behaviour (listed under measured.mutation.survivors).

outside() omits CoachingCore/r2-r5, artifacts and root JSONs; committed changes to runtime-read r5/PROGRAM_POLICY_R5.json, r4/PRESCRIPTION_ENVELOPE_REGISTRY.json, a new file in r5/, and an unbound runtime-read r5 SSCTR review pass --preserved and --check. Untracked files are ignored by --preserved and --check.

On 21838cb v1rfc-freeze --check 1 names r7b-repertoire.mjs and the 8 added files plus the nested V1RWS drift (not r7b-repertoire.mjs alone); v1rws --check 2 names only r7b-repertoire.mjs; v1rc --check 1 names r6-adaptation.mjs and r7b-repertoire.mjs and already failed at 2dfa216.
I10, V6 fails at its first assertion, so its remaining checks no longer run in the suite on this line; only v1str-freeze --preserved/--write carry them.

No upper bound on logged sets (200,000 counted), fractional reps count, rows without athleteId accepted, restarted plans reuse session ids (24 shared; the date window keeps old reports out in the tested restart). Engine-made corrections and conflicts read correctly.
